gaps.lead: The tickets are certain to be expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: be bound to do = be certain to do.

gaps.lead: You can only get a seat if you book well in advance.
gaps.explanation: if you don't book = without booking.

gaps.lead: The plane left the runway moments before the storm hit.
gaps.sentence: The plane had ___ the storm hit.
gaps.explanation: had just + participle = a moment before.

gaps.lead: Her French improved because she spent years in Lyon.
gaps.sentence: Her French improved as ___ in Lyon.
gaps.explanation: as a result of + noun/-ing = because of.

gaps.lead: Everyone thought the concert was excellent.
gaps.explanation: 'Everyone thought it excellent' → 'made an excellent impression on everyone'.
